title: Causal Reasoning with Bipartite Graphical Causal Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.19831v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Causal Bayesian networks (CBNs) and structural causal models (SCMs) are the dominant frameworks for graphical causal reasoning, but they cannot adequately represent all real-world causal systems. In particular, systems at equilibrium---where feedback mechanisms create cyclic causal dependencies---can exhibit causal semantics that are fundamentally incompatible with these frameworks: different interventions that enforce the same variable value may have different effects, rendering the standard ``perfect intervention'' do($X = x$) ambiguous. We propose bipartite graphical causal models (BGCMs), in which the structure of a system of equations is encoded by a bipartite graph with variable and equation nodes. In this framework, a hard intervention do($f_j : X_v = \xi_v$) specifies which equation is replaced, which variable is targeted, and at what value---resolving the ambiguity of the standard notion. translated_title: 基于二分图因果模型的因果推理
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.19831v1 公告类型：新 摘要：因果贝叶斯网络（CBNs）和结构因果模型（SCMs）是图形化因果推理的主流框架，但它们无法充分表示所有现实世界的因果系统。特别是，处于平衡状态的系统——其中反馈机制产生循环因果依赖——可能表现出与这些框架根本不相容的因果语义：不同的干预措施即使强制相同的变量值，也可能产生不同的效果，使得标准的“完美干预”do($X = x$)变得模糊不清。我们提出了二分图因果模型（BGCMs），在该模型中，方程系统的结构通过一个具有变量节点和方程节点的二分图来编码。在此框架下，硬干预do($f_j : X_v = \xi_v$)指定了哪个方程被替换、哪个变量被针对以及被设定的值——解决了标准概念的模糊性。我们通过一个详细的案例研究来展示这一特性。
tldr: 本文提出二分图因果模型（BGCMs），通过二分图编码方程结构，明确干预指定替换方程、目标变量及值，解决了标准完美干预在循环因果系统中的歧义问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Bipartite Graphical Causal Models (BGCMs), encoding equation structures via bipartite graphs, where interventions specify replaced equations, targeted variables, and values, resolving ambiguity of standard perfect interventions in cyclic causal systems.
